Great crowd and discussion at the Tucson Rotary Club today. 

The cost of living is top of mind for a lot of Arizonans right now and the war with Iran has only made it worse. I’m working hard to bring down costs and put money back in families’ pockets.

Since being elected to the Senate, I’ve been supportive of a strong defense budget, but a 46% increase when Americans are struggling to pay for groceries and utilities is irresponsible and ridiculous. We can protect ourselves by having the right capabilities, not just adding money for things that are very expensive and won’t work. 
 
This administration falsely thinks that if you just spend more money, you are safer. It doesn’t work like that. Equipping the military adequately, thinking ahead, a

I never imagined that after meeting Matt during his deployment to Poland last year, I’d be on the phone with him and his wife today as she was released from ICE detention.

I’m happy Annie is back with her husband and family where she belongs. They never should have gone through this painful process, but far too many families like theirs are because of this administration.

"A whole civilization will die tonight” are words no President of the United States had ever spoken until this morning. Donald Trump’s behavior is unhinged and making Americans less safe. After a 25-year career in the United States Navy, I have never met or served with anyone who so completely lacks the qualities of good leadership as Donald Trump does.

If the President takes the actions he has threatened to take, countless Iranian civilians will die, it will massively escalate this war, and th

Threatening to target power plants and other non-military targets is not strength. If those words become orders to destroy civilian infrastructure with no valid military purpose, it’s hard to see how they would not violate the laws of armed conflict. America leads best with strength, discipline, and professionalism. Illegal orders to make civilians suffer would be a black mark on our military and our country.

At the Johnson Space Center for the Artemis II lunar flyby today. Had to get some time in on the simulators in case they need me on the next mission.

Video
  



Video

Right now, the Artemis II crew is flying by the Moon, over 250,000 miles from Earth. Further than Apollo. Further than any human in history. 

Congratulations to Reid, Victor, Christina, Jeremy, and everyone who worked to make this possible.


NASA Earth (@NASAEarth)

New record🥇 

The Artemis II astronauts are now farther from Earth than humans have ever been! At 1:57 p.m. EDT, they broke the record set by Apollo 13 in 1970.

Fox News can confirm that the 2nd crew member of the downed F15E fighter jet has been rescued and he and the members of the rescue team that extracted him from behind enemy lines in Iran are all safely out of Iran. From my family to yours, happy Easter, Arizona! Hope everyone has a safe and fun day with your friends and family!🐰

Flying combat missions over enemy territory is one of the most dangerous things our military does, and combat search and rescue can be even more dangerous. I know they are doing everything they can to bring this crew home safe.


CBS News (@CBSNews)

BREAKING: U.S. forces rescued one crew member from the downed F-15E fighter jet over Iran, two U.S. officials say. cbs

People should be really proud of our country right now. I know I am.

There aren't many countries that step up and try to do the impossible. We do. We landed on the Moon. We're going back right now. And we're not stopping there.

Video
What a great day for our country. 🇺🇸🚀

Artemis II is officially on the way to the Moon with three great Americans and one great Canadian.

Video
Chag Sameach, Arizona! To all those celebrating in Arizona and around the world, @GabbyGiffords and I send our best wishes. We hope you have a meaningful Seder with family and friends.

When I look up at that rocket and the four astronauts sitting on top of it, I see America at its very best. Our country is deeply divided and we have real challenges. But I'd encourage everyone to watch this launch today and be proud of our country and what we're capable of when we work together.


NASA (@NASA)

The hatch is now closed.

The Artemis II astronauts are now strapped into their seats and ready for launch.
